entry.name: jit.anim.drive
entry.description: Animates relative transforms over time with easing. The jit.anim.drive object works in conjunction with jit.anim.node and OpenGL objects to perform this function. Double clicking the object will open a ui mapping dictionary, allowing certain user interface actions to be mapped to animation messages.

attributes.name: active
attributes.digest: Currently animating
attributes.description: Indicates if the object is currently animating.

attributes.name: annotation
attributes.digest: Common Max box / inspector attribute (shared across objects; not necessarily listed in this object’s refpage XML).

attributes.name: automatic
attributes.digest: Automatic updates
attributes.description: Enables automatic update messages (default = 1). Requires theobject to belong to a valid OpenGL context.

attributes.name: drawto
attributes.digest: Assign to named drawing context.
attributes.description: Assign to the named drawing context, allowing for updates to be received automatically.

attributes.name: ease
attributes.digest: Ease time
attributes.description: Set bothandattributes (default = 1.).

attributes.name: easefunc
attributes.digest: Easing mode
attributes.description: Determines how the easing is applied (default = linear).

attributes.name: easein
attributes.digest: Ease-in time
attributes.description: Determines how long it will take (in seconds) for a specific animation message to go from it's current value to the new value (default = 1.). This attribute only affects the,andanimations.

attributes.name: easeout
attributes.digest: Ease-out time
attributes.description: Determines how long it will take (in seconds) for a specific animation message to go from it's current value to 0 (default = 1.). This attribute only affects the,andanimations.

attributes.name: evalreport
attributes.digest: Enable/disable evaluation parameter reporting
attributes.description: Enable/disable the evaluation parameter reporting out the dumpout (default = 0). The report is a 3 element list where each element represents the current evaluation parameters for the,, andmessages, in that order.

attributes.name: fixed_delta
attributes.digest: Lock animation to a fixed rate
attributes.description: Locks the delta time value used when animating, in seconds (default = 0). When non-zero, updates are calculated using this value, rather than the actual time between frames. Useful for non realtime frame capture. If non-zero will override that of the boundvalue.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Causes the animation messages to be output, if currently animating.

messages.digest: Dictionary input to set the ui mapping
messages.description: The incoming dictionary is cloned and used to set the ui mapping.

messages.name: grow
messages.description: Scale the attached object along each axis by the amount provided. The axis arguments are multiplied by.

messages.name: move
messages.description: Move the attached object along the axis provided, relative to the space indicated by the objects'sattribute. The axis arguments are multiplied by.

messages.name: moveto
messages.digest: Move to a position over a specified time
messages.description: Move the attached object to the specified position over the specified length of time (in seconds). Easing in and out is applied to the movement based on theattribute.

messages.name: rotateto
messages.description: Rotate the attached object to the specified quaternion orientation over the specified length of time (in seconds). Easing in and out is applied to the rotation based on theattribute.

messages.name: scaleto
messages.description: Scale the attached object to the specified scale value over the specified length of time (in seconds). Easing in and out is applied to the scaling based on theattribute.

messages.name: springto
messages.digest: Move to a position using mass-spring simulation
messages.description: Move the attached object to the specified position using a mass-spring simulation.

messages.name: turn
messages.description: Rotate the attached object along each axis by the amount provided. The axis arguments are multiplied by.

messages.name: ui_key
messages.description: Send the specified key. If the key is in the ui mapping dictionary, the corresponding animation will be enabled.

messages.name: ui_keyup
messages.description: Send the specified keyup. If the key is in the ui mapping dictionary, the corresponding animation will be disabled.

messages.name: ui_mouse
messages.description: Send the mouse event. If the event is in the ui mapping dictionary, the corresponding animation will be enabled.
